preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each test case must have a positive integer n between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, k must be a non-negative integer not exceeding n.
The sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 2,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k == n - 1 else any(len(set(A)) == n and sum(1 for i in range(n) if A[i] == i + 1) == k for A in permutations(range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: If k equals n - 1, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation A of length n with exactly k indices where A[i] equals i + 1.
